en: Move Deleter
Ahem! I'm the Move Deleter. I can make a Pokémon forget a move, even one a Hidden Machine taught it.
Shall I make one of your Pokémon forget a move?
Which Pokémon?
{thing}? Should that move be forgotten?
There! {wearer} has forgotten {thing} completely.
Come again if there are moves you'd like forgotten.
That's an Egg. It doesn't know any moves to forget!
That Pokémon knows only one move. I can't make it forget that one.
Dragon Tamer
Hm. A visitor to the dragon tamers' town. We keep a secret here: the mightiest of all the Dragon-type moves.
Would you have me teach it to one of your Pokémon?
Back again? Shall I teach the best Dragon-type move I know to one of your Pokémon?
Good. Choose the Pokémon I am to teach.
One, two, and... poof! {wearer} forgot {forgotten}. And...
{wearer} learned {thing}!
Its power to destroy is a fearsome thing to see.
Mind, though: using it lowers the user's own Special Attack.
Well, should you change your mind, do come back.
Not one of the Pokémon with you now can learn this move. Bring a Dragon, and come back.
Teaching a move to an Egg is a feat beyond anyone.
I'm sorry. That Pokémon cannot learn this move.
Oh? That Pokémon knows {thing} already.
That Pokémon could learn this move, but it hasn't come to trust you fully yet.
Until it does, I can't make it learn.
{wearer} did not learn {thing}.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that. {wearer} did not learn {thing}.
